Now let me look at the fuzz_data_producer and fuzz_helpers to understand how the input data is parsed.

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/ossfuzz -name "fuzz_data_producer*" -o -name "fuzz_helpers*" | head && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/ossfuzz/fuzz_data_producer.h 2>/dev/null | head -100</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
